{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.42

|gr1= GUI Control - ListNBox

|descr= Sets the cell picture's colour.

|p1= idc: [[Number]]

|p2= row: [[Number]] - 0-based index (first column is 0, second is 1, etc)

|p3= column: [[Number]] - 0-based index (first column is 0, second is 1, etc)

|p4= colour: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= ctrl [[lnbSetPictureColor]] [<nowiki/>[row, column], colour]

|p21= ctrl: [[Control]]

|p22= row: [[Number]] - 0-based index (first column is 0, second is 1, etc)

|p23= column: [[Number]] - 0-based index (first column is 0, second is 1, etc)

|p24= colour: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>lnbSetPictureColor [1492, [1,0], [0,0.75,0.3,0.5]];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>ctrl lnbSetPictureColor [[0, 3], [1,0,0,1]];</sqf>
